intro: The legal register of complaints, non-conformities and recalls of the PPE we place on the market (Reg. (EU) 2016/425 art. 8). Entries are never deleted: a correction is a note.

keeper.title: Who keeps the register
keeper.body: For brand-label styles the brand is the legal maker and keeps its own register; we keep the same entries here and share them with the brand.

noAccess.title: The PPE register is not for your role
noAccess.body: Seeing the register needs the permission compliance.register.view. The owner or an administrator grants it in Admin › Roles.

tile.riskHint: Open, risk decided: yes (the authority must be told)
tile.assessingHint: Open, nobody has decided the risk yet
tile.uninformedHint: Open entries not yet marked as informed

kindHint.COMPLAINT: A customer or a distributor reported a problem.
kindHint.NON_CONFORMITY: We found garments that do not conform.
kindHint.RECALL: Garments are called back from the market.

riskHint.NO: The PPE does not present a risk to the wearer.
riskHint.ASSESSING: Nobody has decided yet whether the PPE may present a risk.
riskHint.YES: The PPE may present a risk: the market surveillance authority must be told (art. 8(8)).

list.exportNothing: Nothing to export in this view
list.exportViewHint: The {count} rows shown, in a spreadsheet
list.failedTitle: The register could not be read

empty.title: The register is empty
empty.body: Entries come from complaints, non-conformities, releases taken back and failed lab results – or New entry.

held.manage: Your role can see the register; changing it needs compliance.register.manage.
held.closed: A closed entry never changes: add a note in its thread instead.
held.actionDone: The corrective action is recorded as done: add a note instead of rewriting it.
held.informed: The distributors are already recorded as informed.
held.notified: The authority is already recorded as notified.
held.viewSetsRisk: This view already chooses the risk
held.atMax: The list shows at most {max} entries: narrow the filters or search.
held.noSubject: This entry names no batch or serial to trace.

new.title: New register entry
new.subtitle: What happened, to which garments, and whether the PPE may present a risk.
new.styleHint: The style of the garments concerned.
new.styleNoRight: Your role cannot list styles (product.styles.view): ask someone who can to add the entry.
new.batchesHint: As printed on the garment labels. Enter adds one.
new.serialsHint: For a style with one serial per garment. Enter adds one.
new.traceHint: Finds the work orders, the shipments that left with their DDTs and the customers, before you add the entry.
new.traceNeeds: Choose a style and add a batch number or a serial first.
new.traceFailed: The garments could not be traced
new.traceRefused: A batch, serial or style was refused as it is: check them.
new.descriptionHint: In plain words: what was found or reported, and how we learnt it.
new.reporterHint: The customer or distributor who reported it, when there is one.
new.reporterNoRight: Your role cannot list customers (parties.view): the reporter can be added later by someone who can.
new.risk: May the PPE present a risk?
new.actionTakenHint: Optional. The corrective action is recorded as done later, on the entry.
new.reference: The entry takes its reference from the company’s PPE register numbering when it is added.

problem.style: Choose the style of the garments.
problem.recallNeedsGarments: A recall names what it calls back: add a batch number or a serial.
problem.tooManyBatches: At most 50 batch numbers in one entry.
problem.tooManySerials: At most 500 serials in one entry.
problem.noSeries: This company has no PPE register numbering yet: Admin › Documents & numbering sets it.
problem.refused: The entry was refused as it is: check the style, batches and serials.

done.actionSaved: {reference}: the corrective action is saved (not done yet).
done.actionDone: {reference}: the corrective action is recorded as done.
done.informed: {reference}: the distributors are recorded as informed.
done.notified: {reference}: the authority is recorded as notified.

trace.shippedGoods: Some garments have left: the distributors who received them must be informed (art. 8(4)).
trace.noShippedGoods: None of these garments has left the factory.

record.reloadFailed: The entry could not be read again: it shows its last copy. Try again in a moment.
record.closedBody: A closed entry never changes: a correction is a note in its thread.
record.sourceLot: A lab result of the material lot (Cr VI)

affected.title: Affected units
affected.sub: Where every garment of these batches and serials is now: made, released, packed, shipped (with the DDT and the customer) or returned.
affected.none: No work order matches what this entry names.

event.title: What happened
event.sub: As reported or found, and where it came from.

assess.title: Risk assessment
assess.sub: Whether the PPE may present a risk, and what the investigation found.

corrective.title: Corrective action
corrective.sub: What was done to bring the PPE into conformity (art. 8(8)).

duties.title: What the law asks
duties.sub: Each duty of this entry, whether it applies now and whether it is met.

RISK_ASSESSMENT.name: Risk assessed
RISK_ASSESSMENT.OK: Someone decided whether the PPE may present a risk
RISK_ASSESSMENT.OPEN: Nobody has decided yet whether the PPE may present a risk
RISK_ASSESSMENT.fix: Assess the risk: yes or no.

CORRECTIVE_ACTION.name: Corrective action
CORRECTIVE_ACTION.OK: The corrective action is recorded and done
CORRECTIVE_ACTION.OPEN: The corrective action is not recorded as done
CORRECTIVE_ACTION.fix: Record the corrective action (or why none is needed) and mark it done.

DISTRIBUTORS.name: Distributors informed
DISTRIBUTORS.OK: The distributors who received the garments are recorded as informed
DISTRIBUTORS.OPEN: Garments have left: the distributors who received them are not recorded as informed
DISTRIBUTORS.NOT_NEEDED: No garment has left: nobody to inform
DISTRIBUTORS.fix: Tell them, then record how and when.

AUTHORITY.name: Authority notified
AUTHORITY.OK: The market surveillance authority is recorded as notified, with its reference
AUTHORITY.OPEN: The PPE may present a risk: the authority is not recorded as notified
AUTHORITY.NOT_NEEDED: Only when the PPE may present a risk
AUTHORITY.fix: Notify the authority, then record the date and its reference.

toClose.title: Closing the entry
toClose.ready: Every duty is met: the entry can be closed with a reason.

distributors.title: Distributors
distributors.sub: Who received garments of these batches (art. 8(4)).
distributors.where: The customers are on the Affected units tab; write to them from the thread.

authority.title: Market surveillance authority
authority.sub: When the PPE may present a risk (art. 8(8)).
authority.neededYes: Yes: the PPE may present a risk
authority.neededAssessing: Not known until the risk is assessed

dialog.conflict: Someone changed this entry in the meantime: it has been read again. Check and confirm once more.

refused.edit: The event could not be saved
refused.risk: The risk assessment could not be saved
refused.action: The corrective action could not be saved
refused.distributors: The information to distributors could not be recorded
refused.authority: The notice to the authority could not be recorded
refused.close: The entry cannot be closed yet

edit.title: Edit the event
edit.sub: What happened and who reported it. The batches, serials and style stay as reported.

risk.title: Assess the risk
risk.sub: Decide whether the PPE may present a risk to the wearer, and write what the investigation found.
risk.yesWarning: With a risk, the market surveillance authority must be told at once, and the entry closes only with its reference.
risk.investigationHint: What was checked and what was found.

action.title: Corrective action
action.sub: What is done to bring the PPE into conformity, to withdraw it or to recall it – or why nothing is needed.
action.textHint: Once recorded as done it does not change; later facts go in a note.
action.doneOnHint: Not in the future, not before the day it was reported.
action.law: Reg. (EU) 2016/425 art. 8(8): the maker takes the corrective action needed at once.

inform.title: Distributors informed
inform.sub: Record when and how the distributors who received the garments were told.
inform.recordsOnly: This records that you told them; it sends nothing. Write to them from the entry’s thread or by your own means.
inform.nobody: The trace finds no customer who received these garments.
inform.noteHint: Kept as a note in the entry’s thread.
inform.needsNote: Say how and whom you informed.

notify.title: Authority notified
notify.sub: Record the notice to the market surveillance authority and its reference.
notify.recordsOnly: This records the notice you sent (for example through Safety Gate or ICSMS); it sends nothing.
notify.referenceHint: Their number for the notice (or the Safety Gate / ICSMS number).
notify.note: Which authority, and what was sent
notify.noteHint: Kept as a note in the entry’s thread.
notify.needsNote: Say which authority and what was sent.

close.title: Close {reference}
close.sub: Say why the entry is closed. The register keeps it, unchanged, for good.
close.stillOpen_one: {count} thing still stops it from closing:
close.stillOpen_other: {count} things still stop it from closing:
close.reasonHint: For example: action done, no further complaints, authority answered.
close.final: A closed entry never changes: later facts go in a note.
close.needsReason: Say why the entry is closed.
